## Step one

See [the broken thing](../troubleshooting/broken-thing.md#fix).

> Keep the app open while you follow these steps.

1. Open the app.
2. Pick a model.
3. Write a prompt.
4. Pick a size.
5. Pick a count.
6. Add a reference image.
7. Check the credits.
8. Start the run.
9. Wait for the result.
10. Open the result.
11. Save the result.

Enough steps that the page scrolls, so the table of contents has a section
to follow.
